positions.pos: In the clothing kit, a long robe's side opening is where the robe hangs from the belt: front and back panels hang free below the Band, and trousers always fill the gap. Short robes keep hip slits.
positions.why: Your note on robe-layers-look-03: "The slit isn't a slit, it's the place where the robe is attached by the belt and hangs freely from the back part."

questions.q: Do the nine-piece clothing kit and its three robes look right to build?
questions.why_you: Round 0 of the clothing kit you asked for: one set of nine pieces (Shell, Tube, Bell, Panel, Wrap, Band, Lip, Drape, Tassel) that every robe is built from, shown alone and as three outfits on Average Dusk (novice, practitioner, elder), each from the front, mid-step and seated. Stills only, no game code. Your note on robe-layers-look-03 is in: the long robes open at the belt, front and back hanging free below it. The art director checked twice; hem edges, one-piece sleeves, covered shoulders and the outer robe staying off the inner are fixed. What the stills cannot settle yet and round 1's checks will: the hip under the belt on the walk, cuff edges that float off the sleeve when seated, the elder's wide sleeves on the lap, and back views. The full page has references and our past robes.
questions.not_before: The round 0 page and stills are up.
